instructions: Did the respondent mention the Harbour & Pine loyalty app?

classes.yes_negative: mentions the loyalty or rewards app and is unhappy with it
classes.yes_positive: mentions the loyalty or rewards app and is happy with it
classes.not_mentioned: does not talk about the loyalty or rewards app

instructions: Which survey question is this comment mainly about?

classes.staff: How would you rate our store staff?
classes.delivery: How would you rate the delivery of your order?
classes.product: How would you rate the quality of the product?
classes.billing: How easy was it to pay and get your invoice or refund?
classes.none_of_these: about something no listed question asks, or not a real answer

instructions: Which team should own this comment?

classes.billing: invoices, charges, refunds, payment, prices at the till
classes.delivery: couriers, delivery dates, tracking, items damaged or missing on arrival
classes.store_staff: behaviour, helpfulness or availability of store employees
classes.facilities: car park, building, lifts, lighting, signage
classes.digital: website, loyalty app, login, online account
classes.product: product quality, defects, assembly, how the item matches its description
classes.none: nothing a team could act on, or not a real answer

instructions: Does this comment describe a problem that is still unresolved for the person?

classes.unresolved: a problem of their own that is still open: waiting for a refund, item, fix or reply
classes.not_unresolved: no open problem: praise, a past annoyance, a general opinion, or already resolved

instructions: Which known issue does this comment report?

classes.late_delivery: order arrived after the promised date, or the whole order is overdue
classes.billing_error: charged the wrong amount, charged twice, or the invoice or statement is wrong
classes.damaged_item: item arrived broken, cracked, dented or chipped
classes.app_login: cannot sign in to the loyalty app, or keeps being logged out
classes.none: no complaint, or a complaint about something else

instructions: Earlier this customer reported: {issue}. According to this new answer, what is the state of that problem now?

classes.fixed: says the earlier problem has been resolved, or did not happen this time
classes.still_happening: says the same problem is continuing or happened again
classes.worse: says the problem has grown or caused further harm
classes.not_mentioned: does not talk about the earlier problem

instructions: Does this survey question have a wording problem?

classes.leading: wording pushes the respondent toward a particular answer
classes.double_barrelled: asks about two different things in one question
classes.vague_time_frame: unclear period or frequency, such as 'recently' or 'regularly'
classes.jargon: uses internal terms or abbreviations a respondent may not know
classes.sensitive: asks for private information such as income, health or religion
classes.overlapping_options: answer options overlap or leave gaps
classes.fine: clear, neutral, one topic, and the options fit

instructions: Which question type fits this survey question best?

classes.rating: rate one thing on a scale
classes.multiple_choice: pick from a list of options
classes.matrix: rate several items on the same scale
classes.open_text: answer in the respondent's own words

instructions: Given this latest note on the contact, should a survey invitation go out now?

classes.send: nothing in the note makes this a bad time
classes.hold: a temporary situation makes this a bad time: open complaint, dispute, illness, bereavement, away
classes.dont_send: the contact should not be surveyed at all: deceased, asked for no contact, legal action, wrong person

instructions: Which seniority level does this job title belong to?

classes.individual_contributor: does the work directly, no people management
classes.manager: manages a team, shift or store
classes.senior_management: senior manager or head of a function
classes.director: director level, including assistant or associate director
classes.executive: C-level, vice president, managing director, owner or founder
classes.cant_tell: the answer does not show a level, or is not a job title

instructions: Which industry does this answer describe?

classes.healthcare: hospitals, clinics, medical and dental care
classes.cant_tell: none of these, or not an industry

instructions: Could this anonymous employee comment reveal who a specific person is?

classes.identifies_writer: a unique role, shift, location, tenure or event could reveal who wrote it
classes.names_someone_else: names or clearly points to another specific person
classes.safe: no specific person could be identified

instructions: What kind of reply to a survey invitation email is this?

classes.unsubscribe: asks to stop receiving emails or to be removed
classes.wrong_person: says the email reached the wrong person, or the person has left
classes.out_of_office: automatic reply saying the person is away
classes.feedback: gives their opinion or experience instead of taking the survey
classes.question: asks about the survey or how to take it
